Target company.summary_text: Concluded equity value (100%) is GHS 99,084k (US$ 9,090k), 5.2x FY0 EBITDA. The 60% stake is worth GHS 59,451k, or GHS 9.91 per share, on a controlling, non-marketable basis.

Sector.summary_text: DCF EV GHS 105,504k vs trading comps 135,290k and precedents 157,869k. The DCF terminal value implies an exit at 3.4x EBITDA against a 6.6x peer median: the 24% WACC (with size and company-specific premiums) drives the gap.

Valuation date.summary_text: Buying at 6.0x (15% above concluded EV) gives the sponsor a 23.5% IRR and 2.88x MOIC, below the 25% hurdle (18.2% in US$). EBITDA growth creates 78% of the gain.

FY0 adjusted EBITDA.summary_text: Structure tested: Post-LBO (senior + mezzanine). Peak leverage 3.0x vs 3.5x covenant, minimum interest cover 1.9x vs 2.5x; 5 covenant test(s) breached. Verdict: COVENANT BREACH FORECAST — RESTRUCTURE TERMS.

Model integrity.summary_text: Loan YTM 19.9% vs required 19.0%: UNDERPRICED — attractive. Loss-adjusted return 18.7% (meets hurdle). Senior recovery in distress 75%; fulcrum: Senior debt (incl. our loan).

PRIVATE EQUITY — TARGET VALUATION.summary_text: Standalone fund case: LP net IRR 13.4% and TVPI 1.70x after a carry true-up of GHS 15,177k (14.9% before it). KS-PME 1.30x: outperformed public market.

Enterprise value — DCF (method selected).summary_text: Standalone VC case: round 1 pre-money GHS 15,835k, round 2 pre-money GHS 48,537k; founders keep 63% at exit.

Enterprise value — trading comparables.summary_text: Checks: ALL CHECKS PASSED — 1 WARNING(S). FX 10.90 GHS per US$. WACC 24.1% (17.7% in US$).

Implied EV / FY0 adjusted EBITDA.summary_text: FCFF: EV GHS 105,504k. FCFF 105,504k, APV 101,012k, FCFE 92,443k, scenario-weighted 103,468k.

Value per share.summary_text: EV 5th to 95th percentile GHS 81,354k to 137,098k (median 107,110k). Probability EV exceeds the LBO entry price: 14%.

PRIVATE EQUITY — LEVERAGED BUYOUT.summary_text: Score 2.9 of 5 (Weak), implying a 3.2% company-specific premium; premium used 3.0%.

Entry EV / EBITDA.summary_text: Net claims GHS 10,016k incl. US$ debt cost 516k. DLOM used 20.0% (put model 9.3%).
